reservoir_ep15_001.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep15_001.text: The Liang receiver began with two current signed marks: twelve litres at the morning interval and twelve at the evening, twenty-four daily. The morning draw began at six, the evening at eighteen. Her adult daughter collected the first after night work; the mother collected the second. The daughter consented to that broad account and kept her employer's private paper folded. Yue wrote only what had actually been offered. Equal daily water could describe a household whose two members carried different parts of its time cost.

reservoir_ep15_002.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep15_002.text: The Ren receiver showed one permitted twenty-four-litre draw at seventeen. Her household then held an ordinary cleaning interval at the shared collection bay from eighteen-thirty to nineteen. She placed the demonstration bucket on the dry floor and showed the low drain that made their work slow. The bucket remained hers. Cleaning was an actual ordinary duty, not a preference somebody could wave away because the aggregate water total matched. She asked the Liang receiver to say exactly which new interval had been proposed.

reservoir_ep15_003.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep15_003.text: The proposal split the Liang morning twelve into six, keeping the existing evening twelve and adding six at eighteen-forty-five. The total would remain twenty-four across three intervals. The adult daughter hoped a lighter morning collection would let her return to sleep sooner. Her mother would take the additional evening trip if its actual time cost proved manageable. Eighteen-forty-five fell inside the Ren cleaning interval. The current marks were valid; the proposed extra interval had not been ratified. Yue saw how a correct addition could conceal two people's new duties and a shared wet path.

reservoir_ep15_004.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep15_004.text: The Ren receiver said the proposal assumed her household's cleaning could simply be shortened. The Liang mother denied having said that, then admitted she had imagined the smaller extra draw would cause little trouble. The daughter asked both women to stop discussing her sleep as if it belonged entirely to the adults who had arranged the water. She was herself an adult, and she wanted to speak. Qiu gave her the next ordinary turn. Yue put down the pen until the woman chose which part of her account could be copied.

reservoir_ep15_005.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep15_005.text: The daughter said the heavier morning collection made her actual rest later. She would offer a limited anonymous diary of collection duration and sleep onset if its recipient and use were named. She would not publish the employer's exact hours, wages or private workplace record. The mother looked surprised by the condition and accepted it. Yue understood that family concern did not supply another adult's consent. A useful comparison could be built from what its owner offered, while the rest remained private and nobody guessed the missing wages.

reservoir_ep15_006.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep15_006.text: The ordinary valve keeper arrived with the current staff schedule. The proposed third interval would add another opening and receiver check, however small its volume. His existing evening shift had a real end. Qiu asked which actual duty could cover the addition rather than assume a cultivator could stand in because she was nearby. No new opening was approved during the meeting. The keeper described his current work and left for the actual draw he was due to supervise. The household question remained unresolved, with its labor now visible.

reservoir_ep15_007.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep15_007.text: Fu asked the Ren receiver whether the cleaning delay came from volume, footing or an awkward drain cover. The answer contained all three, but the cover and narrow exit caused the longest ordinary pauses. A qualified maintenance worker could inspect the physical bay under its owner's consent. Such an inspection would not reveal the Liang daughter's private sleep cost. Yue could see two different useful directions forming: a consented comparison of real household intervals, or ordinary maintenance that changed the physical conditions shared by their work.

reservoir_ep15_008.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep15_008.text: Qiu asked both households whether they wanted those possibilities considered separately rather than presented as one miraculous solution. They agreed. The mother valued a lighter morning trip; the Ren receiver valued a bay that could be cleaned without losing the whole interval. The daughter wanted her limited testimony heard before somebody claimed a repair had solved sleep. Yue heard each particular request. A new drain could help actual movement while leaving the timetable disputed. A diary could clarify the time cost while leaving the wet physical bay unchanged.

reservoir_ep15_009.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep15_009.text: They ended the public hour with the current permitted draws intact and the extra interval unapproved. Both households had named sources and conditions for a later finite project. The adult daughter retained her private employer paper. The Ren receiver carried her own bucket home. Yue helped stack only the low light chairs she had already agreed to move. Nothing in the meeting had authorized a new qi task. Its dramatic change lay in people speaking their own actual limits, which made the easy copied total no longer sufficient.

reservoir_ep15_010.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep15_010.text: At lunch Tian wanted to know whether the disagreement had been solved. Yue said it had become more specific. He considered that a disappointing kind of progress until she described the additional opening nobody had scheduled. He remembered a receiver arriving after his own shift ended and insisting a small parcel could not take real time. The memory made the valve keeper's duty easier to understand. They ate ordinary beans while discussing the difference between a small object and a small request made to somebody already leaving.

reservoir_ep15_011.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep15_011.text: On One Thousand Two Hundred Two, the qualified maintenance worker inspected the collection bay under the owner's actual ordinary consent. Yue attended only its public physical explanation. The drain cover could be replaced with a safer low ordinary fitting, and the exit channel cleared to reduce standing water. Neither change required a stronger qi application. The worker named tools, materials and finite labor, leaving household testimony for its own owners. The physical estimate would be prepared separately from the proposed comparison. Two useful projects still would not fit automatically into one person's accepted days.

reservoir_ep15_012.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep15_012.text: The worker demonstrated the awkward cover while no household draw was underway. He kept the heavier lift within his qualified ordinary method and asked the visitors to stand on the dry side. Yue obeyed instead of offering an untested overhead catch. The adult daughter had not attended, and her sleep account remained outside this physical inspection. The Ren receiver recognized the delayed motion immediately. Her frustration had acquired a visible mechanical cause that could be repaired. That cause was real without proving every part of the household quarrel had always been about metal.

reservoir_ep15_013.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep15_013.text: Fu told Yue afterward that the Liang mother had once helped the Ren household through a difficult winter. The present anger therefore hurt both women more than strangers' disagreement might. Yue asked whether that old assistance created a right to rearrange current cleaning. Fu said no, and wanted the history heard without turning it into a debt. They agreed to let the owners decide whether to discuss it publicly. Knowing a private background did not make it Yue's testimony to use. She could be careful without pretending the history had no human weight.

reservoir_ep15_014.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep15_014.text: On Two Hundred Three, Deng supervised a modest familiar practice and watched Yue's attention move toward the dispute. She released at the agreed stop and admitted she was imagining a timetable that made everyone grateful. Deng asked her to keep that imagined arrangement separate from the present source. In the next safe set she attended to the actual marker instead. The useful lesson did not solve anybody's water. It reminded her how easily the desire to help could make her finish an answer before the people who needed it had spoken.

reservoir_ep15_015.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep15_015.text: The adult daughter visited the public desk later that afternoon to confirm her limited comparison offer. She chose anonymous durations and ordinary sleep onset, shared only with the named finite receiver and a public aggregate summary approved afterward. Her mother could hear the summary but not claim the original private workplace paper. Yue witnessed the scope without copying the paper. The daughter's conditions made a future project possible. They also meant a visitor who chose physical maintenance would not receive the private comparison simply because she cared about the outcome.

reservoir_ep15_016.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep15_016.text: One Thousand Two Hundred Four was an accepted ordinary wage duty. Yue worked the morning four-hour low-table interval with Zhou, comparing storage returns against actual signed owners. A copied board had joined two households under one convenient short name. The receivers were different people and confirmed different return dates. Yue separated the supported entries. The water dispute had sharpened her attention, but the storage source supplied the actual answer. She would not claim one household pattern explained every other copied error in the basin.

reservoir_ep15_017.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep15_017.text: At midday the new clerk asked whether accurate work meant never using abbreviations. Yue said a supported abbreviation could be useful if its meaning remained checkable. The joined household name had lost that meaning. Tian offered the basket as an example of an unmistakable shortened title, and the clerk said it now had too many famous incidents to remain concise. Their meal ended with ordinary laughter. The afternoon's four-hour source checks remained ahead, and none of the workers abandoned them to refine the basket's biography.

reservoir_ep15_018.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep15_018.text: The afternoon interval completed the actual low-table duty. Zhou accepted the eight-hour equivalent and paid three coppers from the course's ninety-six-copper wage line. Five shared days after the visits had now earned fifteen in total. The water project's future role had not started, and its proposed days were not paid again because Yue had listened to a meeting. She kept the received money as personal living funds. Accurate ordinary work could support later choices without turning every interesting question heard during the week into an extra wage.

reservoir_ep15_019.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep15_019.text: On Two Hundred Five, Qiu presented the finite project funding offer to the households. Thirty coppers had actually arrived from twelve in public path-user charges, ten in a civic maintenance grant and eight from the owners' cooperative contribution. Its agreed purposes allowed either a consented household interval comparison or the qualified physical bay work, after the owners ratified the selected plan. The money could fund one such project, not both. Yue's ordinary course wages already covered her six proposed eight-hour record duties, if she accepted one role under its real scope.

reservoir_ep15_020.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep15_020.text: The comparison plan divided the separate thirty into eighteen for actual household observation work, eight for ordinary dated forms and preparation materials, and four for accepted dispatch. Two consenting household workers would each complete three eight-hour equivalents at three coppers. Their paid work was collection and accepted observation, not testimony compelled by money. The adult daughter's private scope remained hers to confirm. Yue would act as a finite ordinary receiver within six course duty days. No instrument measuring her qi belonged to this water project, and no extra basin endorsement followed its records.

reservoir_ep15_021.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep15_021.text: The maintenance plan used eighteen for one qualified worker's six actual ordinary work days, eight for the accepted low fitting and channel materials, and four for actual delivery. Yue's six course duties would receive and compare its ordinary work and operating records within her established low-table range. She would not perform the heavier repair herself or acquire its tools. This plan changed the shared physical bay but purchased no household sleep diary. The thirty-copper fund could support that actual difference without pretending maintenance records answered a question whose private owner had not offered them there.

reservoir_ep15_022.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep15_022.text: The Liang mother preferred the comparison and the Ren receiver preferred the physical work. The daughter said she would accept either ratified finite project but would not let a maintenance report announce her sleep had improved without her own actual account. Qiu wrote that limitation into the physical plan. The mother then said she would not let a diary report erase the bay's awkward cover. Qiu wrote that into the comparison plan. Yue watched the argument become two bounded contracts whose useful outcomes no longer required the other household's concern to be declared foolish.

reservoir_ep15_023.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep15_023.text: Fu asked why Yue could not perform both sets of records across the six days. The actual dates were One Thousand Two Hundred Nineteen, Twenty-four, Twenty-nine, Thirty-four, Thirty-nine and Forty-four, each one accepted eight-hour duty. Household observations and physical receiving overlapped within them. Yue would need to be in different places with different sources. Extra course wage days had not been funded, and the thirty-copper project purse bought one plan. Fu accepted the answer after seeing the actual time map. Wanting a combined story could not put one person into both rooms.

reservoir_ep15_024.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep15_024.text: On Two Hundred Six, the daughter and Ren receiver met privately before choosing what to bring to the next public hour. Yue was not invited and did not follow. Qiu said the owners needed space to decide their testimony. The empty interval tempted Yue to fill it with imagined reconciliation. Instead she went to the garden and helped Jing carry a light bowl already within ordinary reach. Jing's father had produced a bean he considered perfectly formed. Yue admired it as requested and resisted the urge to ask which authority certified its shape.

reservoir_ep15_025.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep15_025.text: At supper Jing asked whether the new water role would affect Yue's later examination practice. Its six real days belonged to the existing ordinary wage schedule and would be retained within the known safe range. Modest qualified practice would occur on separate accepted intervals, with rest before the later registered trials. Yue would report actual fatigue rather than announce that useful public work could never tire her. Jing approved the concrete answer. She had seen candidates use important service as a reason to conceal ordinary depletion, then resent the room for measuring it.

reservoir_ep15_026.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep15_026.text: On Two Hundred Seven, the accepted current comparison measured seventy-two before its quarter-unit sample. Seventy-one and three quarters remained actually usable, with ninety-one and seven eighths percent compatibility. The preregistered quantity applied after sampling and real activity, so the pre-sample seventy-two was not a pass. The compatible portion and changed conditions also remained insufficient. Yue felt the old wish to announce the larger starting number and let it settle without speech. Recorded qualified input had produced actual progress; the withdrawn quarter had produced actual evidence and was no longer hers to use.

reservoir_ep15_027.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep15_027.text: Deng asked whether she wanted to add demand because the threshold now looked so near. She declined. The same finite modest sets, old ceiling and full stops remained the useful work until later actual conditions justified a change. No storage quantity authorized more throughput. They practiced a familiar interruption and ended before fatigue. Yue could feel disappointment and hope at the same time. The new water project would also require her to carry two real needs without inventing an outcome that pleased everyone. The resemblance helped her attend to the room.

reservoir_ep15_028.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep15_028.text: Two Hundred Eight was the next public household hour. The daughter offered her limited anonymous comparison scope again and spoke directly to the Ren receiver about why morning collection mattered. The Ren receiver described the cleaning cover's awkward lift and the wet exit. Both consented to one of the prepared finite plans being selected and performed under its stated limits. Neither offered blanket access to household records. Qiu accepted their actual ratification conditions and set the final role choice for Sixteen. The current water timetable remained unchanged until a later supported household decision.

reservoir_ep15_029.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep15_029.text: The Ren receiver then mentioned the Liang mother's old winter assistance herself. She was grateful for it and angry that gratitude had begun appearing inside conversations about the present cleaning interval. The mother said she had not intended a debt and looked hurt. Yue listened without using Fu's earlier private account as evidence. Here were the actual owners choosing to speak. Qiu asked what each needed changed now. The daughter said she wanted both women to stop making the past decide whose present tiredness was legitimate. The room became quiet enough to hear that request.

reservoir_ep15_030.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep15_030.text: They left the public hour without a theatrical reconciliation. The mother and Ren receiver had agreed not to describe old assistance as a current scheduling debt. Their actual water and cleaning needs remained. Yue helped return the low chairs and thought about the difference between a useful promise and a repaired relationship. The next project would have to perform its chosen work before anybody claimed the quarrel settled. She went to the kitchen hungry, with an unanswered role question and a better understanding of why the owners wanted its limits stated.

reservoir_ep15_031.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep15_031.text: One Thousand Two Hundred Nine was the second accepted ordinary wage duty of this interval. Yue joined Zhou for the morning four-hour low-table checks of returned public equipment. A repaired measure had received its owner's condition mark but not the actual receiving mark at the basin. The new clerk wanted to copy the first into the second space. Yue asked him to wait for the actual receiver. A valid owner's observation did not prove a later transfer had occurred. The parcel remained on its ordinary shelf until the receiving person arrived.

reservoir_ep15_032.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep15_032.text: The receiver arrived before midday with the accepted parcel source. Its ordinary transfer date matched today, while the owner's condition check belonged to yesterday. Tian copied both supported marks separately. The distinction prevented an extra storage day being attached to a transfer that had not yet happened. The proper correction went through the ordinary storage account. Yue had learned enough repeated date mistakes to notice this one quickly, but the actual answer still came from its source. Familiarity made her question more precise, not the unsupported copy more legitimate.

reservoir_ep15_033.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep15_033.text: During the afternoon four-hour interval, the actual remaining condition notices were checked and delivered to their accepted owners. Zhou signed the completed eight-hour equivalent and paid three coppers. The six shared post-visit duties had now actually earned eighteen, with the three days of this episode still approaching their final date. Yue put the payment outside the finite water project money, whose owners had not selected a plan. Her course had funded ordinary wages; the project fund had funded one specific household or physical use. The two sources could cooperate without becoming interchangeable.

reservoir_ep15_034.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep15_034.text: Tian brought his basket to the garden supper and asked everybody to inspect its newly mended bottom. Fu's brother declared it too ugly for flight. Tian said flight had never been the official purpose and looked indignant when everybody remembered it anyway. Yue asked whether he wanted jokes or an actual stitch check. He chose both, in that order. They laughed, then examined the mending with its ordinary owner. The bottom was sound. A small choice about the conversation had let affection and useful attention share the same object without obscuring its condition.

reservoir_ep15_035.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep15_035.text: On Two Hundred Ten, a local trader offered another twenty coppers for the water project if all household diaries were copied into his supply office. He wanted to predict collection demand and called the condition efficient. Qiu brought the offer to the actual owners rather than accept it because more money would make both plans look possible. The daughter rejected its private-data term. The Ren receiver rejected using her cleaning account as a sales prediction. The trader withdrew the offer. The received thirty remained the only accepted project fund, and the finite choice remained real.

reservoir_ep15_036.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep15_036.text: The Liang mother initially asked whether the diaries could simply be made less embarrassing. Her daughter said privacy was not a confession of embarrassment. She had offered a bounded comparison to answer a household question, not her workday for a trader's planning. The mother listened and apologized for the implication. Yue recognized the importance of letting that conversation occur between its actual people. She did not announce herself as the daughter's defender or use the moment to request broader access. The original limited offer remained possible, with its owner's authority more plainly heard.

reservoir_ep15_037.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep15_037.text: Fu asked Yue afterward whether rejecting the twenty had wasted an opportunity. Yue said it had rejected an actual price attached to a different use. If the trader wanted public aggregate information the owners later approved, he could request that through its real scope. His withdrawn money had not become an invisible donor contribution. Fu nodded and admitted she had imagined the two projects completed at once before reading the condition. Yue had done the same for a breath. The imagined combined outcome had depended on people giving something they had chosen to keep.

reservoir_ep15_038.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep15_038.text: At the modest lesson that afternoon, Deng asked about the breath during which Yue imagined both projects. She laughed at being so obvious and said she had nearly forgotten the actual room. He retained the familiar safe demand and worked on attending before intake. Yue noticed the empty cup, the low marker and Deng's tired knee before beginning. The lesson made no decision about household records. It helped her recognize how a pleasant future picture could narrow present attention just as an alarming trace once had. Both would need a full stop.

reservoir_ep15_039.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep15_039.text: On Two Hundred Eleven the Ren receiver invited the households to see the actual wet exit after their current permitted draws and cleaning. The visit used its ordinary safe path and public physical consent. Yue stood with the visitors on the dry side. The narrow channel held a shallow pool because debris caught beneath the old low fitting. The qualified worker pointed out what the maintenance plan would change. The adult daughter acknowledged the real obstruction, then asked whether the source record could also retain her unmeasured sleep concern. Qiu said it would remain an unanswered concern rather than disappear.

reservoir_ep15_040.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep15_040.text: The Liang mother brought the smaller demonstration bucket for the proposed six-litre morning reduction. She wanted the group to feel the ordinary difference in carrying demand, within safe ranges and without assigning it to anyone who declined. The daughter lifted it herself and said the difference mattered. Ren's receiver also tried it and agreed it was lighter than the current morning twelve. Neither demonstration proved the actual sleep gain or permitted the extra evening interval. It gave the concern a physical scale while the comparison's missing time evidence remained to be collected if chosen.

reservoir_ep15_041.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep15_041.text: Yue left the public demonstration with a more uncomfortable decision. Both projects now had visible useful effects: a lighter morning burden whose actual time cost needed consented observation, and a physical bay whose ordinary obstruction could be repaired. Choosing one would disappoint people she understood better than before. That understanding did not create enough hours or accepted money for both. She asked Qiu whether another funded candidate could take the unchosen role. None had accepted available days inside this finite interval. Qiu would not fill the blank with an imaginary willing worker.

reservoir_ep15_042.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep15_042.text: At supper the squash-hating candidate heard the phrase 'imaginary willing worker' and said the kitchen apparently employed one to taste every surplus squash. Yue laughed and then asked whether she wanted a sympathetic listener or a solution. She wanted sympathy, with one possible onion joke. Yue supplied both badly enough to make her laugh. Their ordinary meal did not require the candidate to approve the water role. She knew little of its sources and offered no advice. Yue appreciated a table at which she could be a friend rather than seek another vote.

reservoir_ep15_043.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep15_043.text: On Two Hundred Twelve, Jing checked the actual ordinary preparation materials that could serve the comparison plan. They were water-project forms and containers, not the sleeves measuring Yue's reservoir. Jing knew their ordinary storage procedure and offered the owner a finite custody explanation. The prospective eight-copper purchase would be paid only if that plan was ratified and issued. Under maintenance, its eight would buy the accepted physical fitting instead. The distinction kept one received sum from becoming two convenient stocks before a role had actually been selected.

reservoir_ep15_044.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep15_044.text: Jing asked which work Yue personally wanted, beyond trying to please both households. Yue preferred hearing the limited interval accounts and asking their source questions. She also wanted the physical bay to be less awkward. Jing said she had asked about her work, not the result she wished everybody could receive. Yue admitted the comparison role appealed to her curiosity, while the maintenance record role offered a more tangible ordinary change. She would have to own that preference alongside its lost opportunity. Choosing from affection alone could conceal whose actual work she hoped to perform.

reservoir_ep15_045.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep15_045.text: The Ren receiver heard that Yue was considering comparison and looked disappointed before any selection had occurred. She said the old cover would still be awkward when good diaries were finished. Yue agreed with that specific consequence and offered no promise to repair it afterward without another actual fund. The receiver appreciated the honesty less than the imagined repair would have pleased her. Yue had to accept the cooler conversation. Understanding someone's need did not entitle her to be liked for the choice that left it unmet.

reservoir_ep15_046.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep15_046.text: The adult daughter heard that maintenance remained possible and asked whether Yue would still receive the private diary out of friendship. Yue said no, unless a separate actual purpose and scope were later offered; the finite maintenance role included no such access. The daughter nodded and seemed relieved as well as disappointed. She wanted the question answered and did not want her disappointment used as consent. Their careful exchange made Yue see another kind of meaningful outcome. Losing access could preserve trust, while gaining it could require work more exacting than being thought kind.

reservoir_ep15_047.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep15_047.text: On Two Hundred Thirteen Deng's lesson used the familiar low task at its registered ceiling. Yue completed the four-breath sequence within half a unit total input, with no ordinary breath above an eighth, and retained its already measured quarter-unit useful application. She released fully before answering his question about the water role. Present attention was improving in modest practice. The changed conditions still required their independent recovered trials and next-day checks. Neither public service nor an honest difficult conversation would certify the reservoir for a task its trace had not yet completed.

reservoir_ep15_048.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep15_048.text: After the lesson Deng asked whether choosing comparison would tempt Yue to work late on private diary pages. She admitted it might. The finite six-day role had actual eight-hour duties and no authority to consume the owner's records overnight because the candidate was curious. Under maintenance, she might stay late to watch the physical repair, but the same ordinary duty boundary applied. Deng wanted her to protect real rest before later examination. Yue agreed to the particular limit. Her choice would change the source she handled, not erase the body's need to stop.

reservoir_ep15_049.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep15_049.text: One Thousand Two Hundred Fourteen brought the last ordinary wage day of this episode. In the morning four-hour interval, Yue checked a public kitchen parcel whose owner had attached an ambitious list of things it might later become. Its actual present contents were smaller. The receiver confirmed which items had arrived today and which remained future orders. Yue recorded only the actual stock. Tian wanted to draw a fish beside the hopeful future list, but the new clerk said the list already contained enough creatures nobody had received.

reservoir_ep15_050.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep15_050.text: The afternoon interval completed the supported present-source checks and actual condition notices. Zhou accepted the eight-hour equivalent and paid three coppers. Days Two Hundred Four, Nine and Fourteen had actually earned nine within this episode, bringing the shared post-visit wage total to twenty-one across seven completed days. Eighteen shared duties remained allocated before the later qualifying trials. The water role's six days belonged inside that existing schedule, not beyond it. Yue could now make its choice with received wages, current recovery and a visible map of the hours it would occupy.

reservoir_ep15_051.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep15_051.text: Fu invited Yue to sit in the ordinary garden after work, where no household receiver was waiting for an answer. They watched a child pursue a beetle through the bean row until Jing's father demanded the child spare his leaves. Yue told Fu that she feared disappointing both sides even after choosing one. Fu said that might happen, because each wanted a useful effect the other plan could not provide. The answer was blunt and comforting. A real decision did not guarantee a grateful audience, even when its cost had been explained carefully.

reservoir_ep15_052.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep15_052.text: Fu also said the daughter had asked whether Yue could hear a limited account without treating it as a story to improve. Yue knew the question came from the actual owner and would answer it directly if she chose that role. The maintenance worker had asked whether she could receive ordinary condition notices without telling him how an unqualified cultivator might lift the cover. She could respect that too. Both roles required her to leave somebody else's competent work intact. The chosen work would be interesting partly because it did not make her central to every task.

reservoir_ep15_053.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep15_053.text: That evening the two household receivers met under the ordinary public process and ratified either prepared plan within its stated limits, leaving the finite record role for Yue to select tomorrow. They retained their current permitted water intervals meanwhile. The extra evening opening remained unapproved without a separate actual staffing decision. No project's outcome would be used as a blanket right to private household records or altered draws. The owners wanted real work and a real later review. Qiu placed the two accepted plans on the low desk and closed the meeting on time.

reservoir_ep15_054.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep15_054.text: On Two Hundred Fifteen, Jing's current comparison began with an accepted blank after ordinary rest and morning movement. Seventy-two and a quarter measured usable before sampling. The actual quarter-unit sample left seventy-two, with ninety-two percent compatibility in this present quiet condition. Yue had met the quantity and compatible-portion thresholds here for the first time after their real sample cost. Her stage remained seven. The preregistered changed-temperature, movement and interrupted-sleep series with next-day checks had not been completed. Mei recorded the current progress without signing the certificate it did not yet support.

reservoir_ep15_055.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep15_055.text: Yue wanted to celebrate the clean quiet number, and Deng said she could celebrate its actual meaning. They drank ordinary tea after the comparison and spoke about the safe practice that had preceded it. The recorded input had stayed within the old ceiling, with actual releases, work, sampling and sleep reflected in the present usable state. A measured seventy-two was valuable. It would still need to survive the lives in which she meant to use it. Yue welcomed the result while leaving the harder evidence open, which felt more durable than pretending every remaining condition had become inevitable.

reservoir_ep15_056.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep15_056.text: Qiu brought the two water-role plans to the room after the actual instrument work ended. Yue could choose consented comparison records or ordinary maintenance records for the six scheduled duties. Same wage, same finite hours, different sources and actual effects. Qiu did not recommend the role most likely to flatter a candidate. The households had ratified the alternatives and understood that one useful concern would remain unresolved inside this interval. Yue asked to read them alone once more, then promised an actual answer at the posted desk hour on Sixteen.

reservoir_ep15_057.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep15_057.text: The comparison plan would permit limited anonymous interval and sleep observations offered by their actual owners. Its paid household workers would gather the specified records, while Yue received them and checked their public approved aggregate. The awkward physical cover would remain. The maintenance plan would pay the qualified worker to change the bay's fitting and channel, with Yue receiving its actual operating notices. The private diary would remain unavailable, and household sleep effects could not be inferred from a repaired drain. Yue could name both opportunities now without making either a decorative label for the same work.

reservoir_ep15_058.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep15_058.text: She folded each plan along its existing ordinary crease and remembered the family fare slips. That earlier choice had become real people, dates, payments and missed conversations. This one would become different actual work and a different unanswered concern. She could not postpone until no one might dislike her answer. The adult daughter and Ren receiver would have to live with its effect after Yue's six days ended. She wanted to make a choice she could explain beside the actual source, rather than one requiring their disappointment to be hidden.

reservoir_ep15_059.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep15_059.text: At supper Tian asked whether the vegetable council had developed a view of water policy. Yue said the offended turnip preferred physical maintenance because its crown kept falling into puddles. The river onion preferred diaries but refused to state its working hours. Jing accused them of making vegetables too plausible. Their laughter did not settle the real role. It made room for Yue to arrive at the decision as a person who still enjoyed ridiculous company, rather than a candidate convinced every uncertain hour had to become solemn proof of purpose.

reservoir_ep15_060.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep15_060.text: Before sleep she wrote one question beneath each plan. Under comparison: whose actual time changes, and whose voice remains missing? Under maintenance: what physical work changed, and what human effect has not been measured? The questions would follow her into whichever role she accepted. They would not grant both sets of records. Yue put the papers on the low table, settled the earned small circuit and let the quiet measured seventy-two belong to its own morning. Tomorrow's role would require a choice about other people's lives that no reserve number could make for her.

reservoir_ep15_061.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep15_061.text: The ordinary project receiver clarified the comparison workers' time before leaving. Each would attend four actual hours on each of the six project dates, twenty-four hours apiece across three eight-hour equivalents. Their three-copper installments would be paid after each completed eight hours, nine for each worker and eighteen together. The two ordinary two-hour intervals on every actual selected date included preparation, actual observation and accepted record checking. The adult daughter's limited private diary remained voluntary within its named scope; nobody's wage bought permission to publish the employer paper she had withheld.

reservoir_ep15_062.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep15_062.text: The maintenance worker confirmed six actual eight-hour qualified ordinary days under the alternative plan. His tools would remain his, the accepted fitting would belong to the shared bay, and the delivered materials would be checked before use. Yue's role was six separate funded ordinary record duties inside her existing course schedule. He wanted the final notices to say which physical condition had been inspected and which remained unchanged. A sound channel would be useful without claiming it had measured the daughter's sleep or approved another opening.

reservoir_ep15_063.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep15_063.text: Fu asked whether Yue wanted company at tomorrow's choice desk as she had at the family booking. Yue accepted the same finite help: a quiet walk there and an ordinary meal afterward, with no demand to make the selected plan feel painless. Fu agreed and asked which onions to buy. Yue said the seller's actual small ones, leaving the enormous squash to its admirers. The practical request ended the conversation gently. Friendship could carry a consequential decision without becoming another vote that its chooser had to win.

reservoir_ep15_064.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep15_064.text: At the window Yue watched the public bay's distant lamp reflected on the basin. The shared channel, ordinary workers and household beds were real places, not marks arranged to teach her a lesson. She would enter one finite part of their work and leave another part waiting for a later actual fund or decision. Her current quiet-room result remained progress, while the harder bodily trials lay ahead. She extinguished the lamp and let tomorrow arrive without rehearsing either household's gratitude.
